g.text: Hovering Ember swaps the wallpaper and retints the
real desktop: window grounds, the bar band, the strip.
prismata carries the change across the screen.
Every frame still samples the same rail. Matugen
may move ground, containers and text, never cyan,
blue, purple, rose (or Error / Info / Success / Warning).
Sky / blue / violet / rose on #F6F9FF. Strokes rest
at 0.55, the gleam becomes a darker segment and the
The picker is a strip; Escape returns
96 px, bottom edge, 0 inset, no radius, navy glass over the
windows it covers. Hover leaves: the desktop returns on the
720 ms release. Apply is text with a 2 px underline.

svg.text: Phosphor · wallpaper and theme picker · tries the palette on your real layout
